title: Children ever diagnosed with ADHD, by sex (2022)

source.name: ADHD Prevalence Among U.S. Children and Adolescents in 2022
source.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

notes: Illustrative -- real published 2022 NSCH figures formatted for narration. Boys were diagnosed at roughly 1.8x the rate of girls in 2022, down from more than 2x in prior years -- the sex gap is narrowing as more girls get identified.
